ops.title: Phase 3 — staleness signals S1–S9
ops.description:
**Build on `Verdict`, do not duplicate it.** `verdictOf` and `driftedOf` (`notes/document.go:808,835`) already compute EXPIRED / UNVERIFIED / DRIFTED / STALE / DANGLING from `AnchorWitness` + `VerifiedAt`, with precedence EXPIRED > UNVERIFIED > DRIFTED > STALE. None of it is stored; all is computed on demand. The work is to make it a ranking input and an injection gate, and to add the signals it lacks.

S1–S6 are a **hard non-injection gate** — abstention is a first-class outcome, not a fallback (one measured study found a 17.5% false-positive injection rate without an abstain action, 0.0% with it). S7–S9 are rank penalties that enqueue a re-verify through the existing `note_verify`/`doc_review` surface.

S1 anchor drift or dangling — already implemented, `driftedOf` compares witnessed oids → gate.
S2 superseded (`len(SupersededBy) > 0`) → gate; inject the successor.
S3 explicitly expired (`StaleAt != 0`) → gate.
S4 investigation resolved → exonerated gates; confirmed root cause **promotes** and is exempt from decay.
S5 task terminal or lease expired (`StaleTasks(LeaseTTL)`, default 1h) → drop from the active-work slice.
S6 branch merged or reconciled away — `Reconcile` already reassigns merged branches' tasks → re-anchor to trunk or archive.
S7 churn on the anchored path since record_from → decay ∝ churn.
S8 dead code-element reference — regex-extract backticked/CamelCase/snake_case identifiers, exact-match against the tree (precision over recall by design). **Catches deletion only, not semantic drift**: an identifier that still exists but behaves differently passes silently.
S9 time since last verify, `R = 2^(−Δ/h)`, per-kind h (Doc 90d, Note 60d matching the existing `NoteStaleAfter` default, **Log ∞** — logs are episodic and never go wrong). Δ resets on `VerifyNote`.

ops.text: Table-driven tests per signal against real git fixtures
S1-S6 provably gate: a fixture that deletes an anchored path and rebuilds shows the entity withheld
cc-notes kg stale --explain names the triggering signal per entity
No signal duplicates logic already in verdictOf/driftedOf
